steps.eval: (() => {if(innerWidth>700)return;const scroll=document.documentElement.scrollHeight-innerHeight;if(scroll>308)throw Error('Phone setup scroll '+scroll+'px exceeds 308px');const start=document.querySelector('.start-btn').getBoundingClientRect();if(start.top<0||start.bottom>innerHeight)throw Error('Start Game is below the fold');for(const e of document.querySelectorAll('#setup-screen *')){const b=e.getBoundingClientRect();if(!b.width||!b.height||getComputedStyle(e).display==='none')continue;if([...e.childNodes].some(n=>n.nodeType===3&&n.textContent.trim())&&parseFloat(getComputedStyle(e).fontSize)<13.99)throw Error('Setup text below 14px: '+e.className);if(e.matches('button,input')&&(b.width<43.99||b.height<43.99))throw Error('Setup target below 44px: '+e.className);}})()

(async () => { const start=performance.now();while(!__stbDebug().settled&&performance.now()-start<10000)await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,50));const d=window.__stbDebug();if(d.dpr>2)throw Error('DPR cap exceeded'); if(d.renderer!=='webgl'||!d.settled||d.logicalDice.length!==d.topFaces.length||d.logicalDice.some((v,i)=>v!==d.topFaces[i])) throw Error('Logical dice differ from settled mesh faces: '+JSON.stringify(d)); const r=document.querySelector('.back-btn').getBoundingClientRect();if(!document.elementFromPoint(r.x+r.width/2,r.y+r.height/2)?.closest('.back-btn'))throw Error('Menu covered'); const tiles=[...document.querySelectorAll('#box-area .tile:not(:disabled)')];for(const t of tiles){const b=t.getBoundingClientRect();if(b.width<43.99||b.height<43.99)throw Error('Tile target below 44px');} })()

(() => { const ts=[...document.querySelectorAll('#box-area .tile:not(:disabled)')].map(x=>x.getBoundingClientRect());for(let i=0;i<ts.length;i++)for(let j=i+1;j<ts.length;j++){const a=ts[i],b=ts[j];if(Math.min(a.right,b.right)-Math.max(a.left,b.left)>1 && Math.min(a.bottom,b.bottom)-Math.max(a.top,b.top)>1)throw Error('Tile hit areas overlap: '+JSON.stringify({i,j,a:a.toJSON(),b:b.toJSON()}));} if(getComputedStyle(document.querySelector('#btn-coach')).display==='none')throw Error('Coach hidden'); })()
